findings.title: totalPages off-by-one when count divisible by limit
findings.body: In app/assets/javascripts/admin/controllers/admin-group.js.es6 totalPages is Math.floor(user_count / limit) + 1. When user_count is an exact multiple of limit (e.g. 100 users, limit 50) this returns 3 instead of 2, so the pager shows a non-existent third page that renders empty and enables the next button past the end.

findings.title: next pagination can seek to offset == user_count
findings.body: In app/assets/javascripts/admin/controllers/admin-group.js.es6 the next action clamps with Math.min(offset + limit, user_count). A valid offset is zero-based, so offset equal to user_count points past the last record and returns zero rows. It should clamp to the start of the last page, otherwise the admin can navigate to an empty page.

findings.title: create ignores alias_level selected in UI
findings.body: In app/controllers/admin/groups_controller.rb Admin::GroupsController#create only assigns name and visible, while #update assigns alias_level. The admin form exposes an alias-level combo-box for new groups, so the chosen value is silently dropped and every new group is created with the default level.

findings.title: add_members does not trim usernames
findings.body: In app/controllers/admin/groups_controller.rb add_members does usernames.split(",") and looks up each token verbatim with User.find_by_username. A normal list like "bob, alice" leaves a leading space on the second token, the lookup returns nil, and the user is silently skipped with a success response, so the admin thinks the add succeeded.

findings.title: remove_member bypasses Group#remove logic
findings.body: In app/controllers/admin/groups_controller.rb remove_member calls group.users.delete(user_id) directly, while add_members uses group.add(user). Direct association delete skips any cleanup encapsulated in Group#remove (primary-group reset, counters, callbacks) and passes a raw integer id instead of a User record. This risks leaving inconsistent user/group state compared to the normal removal path.

findings.title: members limit/offset unvalidated
findings.body: In app/controllers/groups_controller.rb GroupsController#members takes limit as (params[:limit] || 50).to_i and offset as params[:offset].to_i with no bounds. A client can request an unbounded limit causing a huge users load and DoS, or a negative/zero limit/offset causing empty results, division-by-zero in the pager, or database errors. The limit needs a maximum and non-negative clamping.

findings.title: automatic check in member row resolves to wrong scope
findings.body: In app/assets/javascripts/admin/templates/group_member.hbs the template rendered per-member with itemView checks {{#unless automatic}}. Inside that item context automatic resolves to the member User, not the group, so it is always falsy and the remove link is shown even for automatic groups where removal is prohibited. The backend rejects it, but the UI incorrectly offers deletion.

findings.title: findMembers changed promise contract
findings.body: In app/assets/javascripts/discourse/models/group.js findMembers now returns undefined when the name is empty instead of Ember.RSVP.resolve([]) as before, and addMembers/removeMember do not return the inner findMembers promise. Callers that chain .then on findMembers will throw on undefined, and callers cannot wait for the reloaded member list after an add or remove.
